mutation_explanation.capacity-failover: Removing only state.kind !== overloaded from the existing wake conjunction is inert at the scheduled capacity retry because ownFree=true. The actual mutant changes only overloaded chats to permit the existing account-failover branch; ordinary account-limit behavior is identical. It posts one account command with viable acc2, then fails the explicit no-switch assertion (actual1, expected0).
mutation_explanation.drop-newer-account-limit: Keep overloaded notice projection intact but return null for an account usage-limit row. The initial overload oracle passes; the strengthened newer-ID oracle fails undefined versus a4. The old optional-chain kind===undefined would accept that null.
